== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player in a blue henley is the ship's-wheel traveler from [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 1.jpg]]. The teammate in a tan vest, glasses, and a blond beard is the same man as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 3.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 18.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 European Championship]] weekend in Bochum, Germany, from the "Team Wales Photo Log" thread.

* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
